title.zh: 像素是怎么到屏幕上的

desc.zh: 一块 4K 屏每秒刷新 120 次，就是每秒要送出近十亿个像素，每个都得在对的时刻亮成对的颜色。它们怎么从显卡的一块内存，经过一根线，变成眼前的光？画面为什么会撕裂、卡顿？十一个可以动手的模型：一帧有多少字节，按真实时序表算像素时钟，撕裂与垂直同步的时间线，可变刷新率与低帧率补偿，颜色管线与查找表，一根线放不放得下一种画面，4:2:0 抽掉了什么，一行像素有多少时间充电，眼睛跟着看时的运动模糊，HDR 的 PQ 曲线，以及从点鼠标到屏幕变亮的延迟。
desc.en: A 4K screen refreshing 120 times a second has to deliver nearly a billion pixels a second, each lit the right colour at the right moment. How do they get from a block of GPU memory, through one cable, to light in front of your eyes, and why does the picture tear or stutter? Eleven hands-on models: how many bytes a frame takes, the pixel clock from real timing tables, a tearing and vsync timeline, variable refresh with low framerate compensation, the colour pipeline and its lookup tables, whether a cable fits a given mode, what 4:2:0 throws away, how long a row of pixels has to charge, motion blur when the eye tracks, the HDR PQ curve, and the latency from mouse click to light.

title.zh: 帧缓冲：一帧就是一块内存
title.en: The framebuffer: a frame is a block of memory

desc.zh: 4K 一帧 RGBA8 约 31.6 MiB，120 Hz 时显示引擎每秒要从显存读走近 4 GB；sRGB 编码把更多码值留给暗部。
desc.en: A 4K RGBA8 frame is about 31.6 MiB; at 120 Hz the display engine reads nearly 4 GB a second from video memory. sRGB encoding spends more codes on the darks.

title.zh: 像素时钟与消隐：按真实时序表算
title.en: Pixel clock and blanking, from real timing tables

desc.zh: CTA-861 的 4K 60 Hz 时序总尺寸 4400 × 2250，像素时钟 594 MHz，一行 7.41 微秒；CVT 精简消隐把消隐从 16% 压到 5%。
desc.en: The CTA-861 4K 60 Hz timing is 4400 × 2250 in total at 594 MHz, 7.41 µs a line; CVT reduced blanking cuts blanking from 16% to 5%.

desc.zh: 不同步就在扫描中途换帧，出现撕裂；垂直同步等到场消隐再换，没撕裂但 48 帧放进 60 Hz 时每帧停 16.7 或 33.3 毫秒，节奏乱了。
desc.en: Flipping mid-scan tears the image; vsync waits for vertical blanking, so no tear, but 48 fps on a 60 Hz screen holds frames for 16.7 or 33.3 ms and the pacing breaks.

title.zh: 可变刷新率与低帧率补偿
title.en: Variable refresh rate and low framerate compensation

desc.zh: 可变刷新率把场前肩拉长，等新帧画好再读；帧率低于屏幕范围时，低帧率补偿把同一帧均匀地重读几遍，前提是最高刷新率至少是最低的两倍。
desc.en: VRR stretches the vertical front porch until the next frame is ready; below the panel range, LFC repeats each frame evenly, which needs a maximum at least twice the minimum.

title.zh: 显示引擎、合成器与颜色管线
title.en: Display engine, compositor and colour pipeline

desc.zh: 显示引擎读几个图层、缩放、叠在一起，再走去伽马查找表、颜色矩阵、伽马查找表；合成器能让出路来时，游戏的帧直接翻到屏上。
desc.en: The display engine scans several planes, scales and blends them, then applies degamma LUT, colour matrix and gamma LUT; when the compositor steps aside, a game frame flips straight to the screen.

title.zh: DisplayPort 与 HDMI：一根线放得下什么
title.en: DisplayPort and HDMI: what fits in one cable

desc.zh: 4K 120 Hz 10 位要 35.64 Gb/s，HBR3 四通道只有 25.92 Gb/s；链路训练经辅助通道写 DPCD 寄存器，一级级调电压摆幅和预加重。
desc.en: 4K 120 Hz at 10 bits needs 35.64 Gb/s, more than HBR3’s 25.92 Gb/s; link training writes DPCD registers over AUX and steps voltage swing and pre-emphasis.

zh: HDMI 和 DisplayPort 哪个好

desc.zh: DSC 把每像素 30 位压到 12 位左右，4K 240 Hz 才放得进 HBR3；4:2:0 让四个像素共用一个颜色，红字蓝底的边缘就糊了。
desc.en: DSC squeezes 30 bits a pixel to about 12 so 4K 240 Hz fits HBR3; 4:2:0 shares one colour among four pixels, so red text on blue smears.

title.zh: 屏里面：时序控制器和一行的充电时间
title.en: Inside the panel: the TCON and the time a row gets

desc.zh: 栅极驱动一次打开一行晶体管，源极驱动同时给这一行充电；4K 60 Hz 一行只有 7.41 微秒，刷新率翻倍，时间减半，晶体管不够快就写不准。
desc.en: The gate driver opens one row of transistors while the source drivers charge it; at 4K 60 Hz a row gets 7.41 µs, and doubling the refresh halves it.

zh: 屏幕是怎么一行一行刷新的
en: how a screen refreshes row by row

desc.zh: 保持型显示一帧亮到底，眼睛跟着运动时边缘被抹开约一帧移动的距离；提高刷新率或插黑帧能缩短，响应慢的液晶再加一截。
desc.en: A sample-and-hold display stays lit all frame, so an eye tracking motion sees edges smeared by about one frame of movement; higher refresh or black frames shorten it.

desc.zh: PQ 按绝对亮度编码，10 位 0 到 10000 尼特，相邻两级亮度差一直接近看得出的门槛；普通伽马拉到 1000 尼特，暗部每级跳得太大。
desc.en: PQ encodes absolute luminance, 0 to 10,000 nits in 10 bits, keeping each step near the visible threshold; a plain gamma stretched to 1,000 nits jumps too far in the darks.

desc.zh: 延迟是一串等待加起来的：鼠标轮询、等下一帧、画和排队、合成器、扫到屏幕中间、像素变过去；最大的一段常常是排队。
desc.en: Latency is a sum of waits: mouse polling, the next frame, render and queue, the compositor, scan-out to mid-screen and pixel response; the queue is often the biggest.

title.zh: 屏幕不对劲时问的三件事
title.en: Three questions when a screen misbehaves

desc.zh: 刷新率选不上去、画面撕裂或一顿一顿、动起来糊或开 HDR 发灰：先问线放不放得下，再问哪两个钟对不上，最后问是像素慢还是数不对。
desc.en: Refresh rate will not go up, tearing or stutter, blur in motion or grey HDR: ask whether the link fits, which two clocks disagree, and whether the pixels are slow or the numbers are wrong.
